description:
Hi! I’m Muthukumaran, a third-year Computer Science student at Chennai Institute of Technology and an OpenAI Student Collective Campus Lead. I enjoy building interactive web apps with React and Python, and I’ve built and demoed AI projects at hackathons.

For NASA Space Apps, I’m building Moonbase Blackout, a short game where students run a lunar outpost. When the power drops, can you keep life support running, grow enough food, and prepare for a solar storm? I want to make those trade-offs fun!
